proofs.text: Call the rule text hash on `Tokens expire after 24 hours`, then call it on the text left by splitting `Tokens  expire   after 24 hours [risk: high]`; verify the two hashes are equal, so neither a doubled space nor a tag changes the rule text hash a signature binds

rule_text: The rule and proof text hashes normalise runs of whitespace to one space, so reflowing or retagging a line returns the hash it already had

tests.body:
def test_the_hash_ignores_the_tags_and_the_whitespace(self):
        plain = purlin_specs.rule_text_hash('Tokens expire after 24 hours')
        tagged, _meta = purlin_specs.split_rule_tags(
            'Tokens  expire   after 24 hours [risk: high]')
        assert purlin_specs.rule_text_hash(tagged) == plain, (
            're-tagging or reflowing a rule must not change its rule text hash')
tests.name: test_the_hash_ignores_the_tags_and_the_whitespace
reasons: expected value computed by same function as SUT
